rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a perceived threat posed by a person, event, or situation.

example.english: That gang is a menace to the whole neighbourhood.
example.traditional: 呢班人對成個社區都係一個威脅。
example.jyutping: ne1 baan1 jan4 deoi3 sing4 go3 se5 keoi1 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 wai1 hip3

rows.note: Use this when “menace” emphasizes the danger or hazardous nature of the situation rather than a threatening force.

example.english: This unlit road is a major menace to pedestrians at night.
example.traditional: 呢條路夜晚冇街燈，對行人嚟講係一大危險。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 lou6 je6 maan5 mou5 gaai1 dang1 deoi3 hang4 jan4 lei4 gong2 hai6 jat1 daai6 ngai4 him2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the act of threatening or intimidating someone.

example.english: They used the phone to menace me and threatened my family.
example.traditional: 佢用電話恐嚇我，話要對我屋企人不利。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 din6 waa2 hung2 haak3 ngo5 waa6 jiu3 deoi3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 bat1 lei6
